mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE is_deleted = 0) employeeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept WHERE is_deleted = 0) deptCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND create_time < CURDATE() AND status = 0 ) yesterdayAttendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_request WHERE status = 0) pendingLeave

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earlyLeave, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS leaveCount FROM attendance WHERE YEAR(attendance_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(attendance_date) = MONTH(CURDATE())

SELECT attendance_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormal FROM attendance WHERE YEAR(attendance_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(attendance_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY attendance_date ORDER BY attendance_date

SELECT a.id, a.employee_id AS employeeId, e.real_name AS employeeName, a.attendance_date AS attendanceDate, a.sign_in_time AS signInTime, a.sign_out_time AS signOutTime, a.status, a.remark FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE YEAR(a.attendance_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(a.attendance_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) ORDER BY a.attendance_date DESC, a.employee_id

SELECT d.id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM dept d LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.dept_id = d.id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY employeeCount DESC, d.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, IFNULL(SUM(days), 0) AS totalDays FROM leave_request WHERE apply_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND apply_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_request WHERE apply_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND apply_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT lr.id, lr.employee_id AS employeeId, lr.start_date AS startDate, lr.end_date AS endDate, lr.days, lr.type, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.approver_id AS approverId, lr.approve_remark AS approveRemark, lr.apply_time AS applyTime, lr.approve_time AS approveTime, lr.create_time AS createTime, lr.update_time AS updateTime, e.real_name AS employeeName FROM leave_request lr LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = lr.employee_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE lr.apply_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND lr.apply_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY lr.apply_time DESC
